TS011 no-star-import

An import names what it brings in, so a reader can tell where a name came from.

languages: go javascript python rust typescript
severity: warning
default: on
group: stable
odin: Odin has no wildcard import; an import binds one package name
zig: Zig has no wildcard import; @import binds one name

TigerStyle: "Minimize the number of variables in scope, to reduce the probability that variables are misused."
NASA P10 Rule 6: "Data objects must be declared at the smallest possible level of scope."
